# packages/rules/test/fixtures

**What's here:** data the tests replay.
**Open this when:** a G1 replay test fails, or you need G1 history as data.

| File             | Purpose                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `g1-ledger.json` | G1 sheet Apr-18..Dec-26 in whole rupees: per month the installment, who paid (`1`/`0`, members `MEMBER 01..12`), Credits/Deductions, UTI, and each member's net Debit cell; plus both copies of outstanding loans. |

Generated by `../../scripts/extract-g1.py`; don't edit by hand. Anonymised: no names, no notes, no bank details.
